description: This file defines the CurlFactoryInterface interface within the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace. It declares methods for creating and releasing cURL handles, which are used for HTTP requests in Guzzle.

classes.name: CurlFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for creating and releasing cURL easy handles used by Guzzle for HTTP requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cURL handle resource with a given request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases an easy handle, making it available for reuse or closure.
